description.description: The description of recent builds. Such as only 2 out of the last 5 builds were unsuccessful

iconClassName.description: The class name of the icon. Essentially gives the build the color (red, yellow, green). Possibly can be used for filtering

iconUrl.description: A png file of the icon. Essentially gives the build the color (red, yellow, green). Possibly can be used for filtering

score.description: The build score. Returns the percentage of the passing rate of recent builds
